flags.removal_verification: every clock-free stage verified (clock_obs, weights, clock_hidden_frac)
flags.speed_driven: steps members' mean delta/R BETTER, mean dlog step_rate_hz >= 0, T z > 0

decision_rule.text: WAVE 2: the baseline is X0x (the c6x extension with the clock held) and the one candidate is W (the hard cut); every "X0" below reads X0x and every wave-1 arm name reads W. Every metric is a per-category number of the suite__omni row (summarize()['cat'][c]: the median pooled over both hands of a paired category; survival = the category's own-hold survival), computed over each category's 12-s command window. The control of every arm is the baseline X0 (control: baseline), never another arm. Blocks (95 %, two-sided): F = turn: facing_closed, yaw_progress; F_mt = move_turn: facing_closed, yaw_progress; T = fwd, side, back, diag: ratio; RIG (rigidity, 10 members) = steps_per_m on fwd, side, back, diag and steps_per_rad on turn (stepping without travel, LOWER is better; a step is an unloaded run of >= 5 env steps; turn uses its whole hold, and the pre/post-closure split is WATCH) plus support_feet (the mean loaded-foot count, force > 50 N) on fwd, side, back, diag, turn (HIGHER is better). Each delta is sign x (candidate - control), so z > R is BETTER in every block; z_b = mean_i(delta_i / R_i); BETTER if z > R, WORSE if z < -R, else TIE. Guards (99 %, one-sided; 23): survival on all seven categories (floored at R_binom); move_turn.ratio; ratio@guard on fwd, side, back, diag; foot_slip (per-foot mean planar speed of loaded feet, lower is better; per foot, so it catches dragging, skating and pivot-skate turns without scaling with support_feet) on fwd, side, back, diag AND turn; steps_per_m@guard on fwd, side, back, diag and steps_per_rad@guard on turn; stand.steps_per_s (stand stillness must not get worse; not decisive, stand stepping is not clock-driven). A guard that is also a block member is resolved under its own key (cat.<c>.<key>@guard). R_i = max(R_eval,i, R_seed,i) (+ R_binom for the survival guards), R_eval from D00s (X08-c6 vs X08-c4), R_seed from D00bs (X0 s3 vs s2). ADOPTION (adopt_requires: RIG): ADOPT = RIG BETTER, nothing WORSE, no floor, anchored drift OK (the drift anchor is pinned to X0). Clear REJECT = any block or guard WORSE, RIG TIE or WORSE while another block is BETTER, or a stage floor -- except the pair_on cases. pair_on [adopt, neutral, lone_guard]: an s3 ADOPT, a NEUTRAL line (RIG TIE, nothing WORSE) and a lone-guard line (RIG BETTER, exactly one guard WORSE, no block WORSE) each queue a seed-2 pair; the s3 entry stays speculative until pooled, the pooled decision is final and again requires pooled RIG BETTER. BALANCED RIG (user, settled decision 11): a WIN, and any ranking of WINs, also needs the steps part and the support part of RIG's z to be >= 0 each; a pooled ADOPT with a negative part is classed NEUTRAL (support_feet resolves at 0.7-2 % against steps at 4-13 %, so RIG must not be won on the loaded-foot count alone). Classes (arm_class; the pooled line when one exists, all against X0; precedence BREAK > RIGID > NEUTRAL): WIN = a pooled ADOPT with both RIG parts >= 0 and removal verification passed; BREAK = F, F_mt or T WORSE, any guard WORSE, or a floor; RIGID = RIG WORSE and nothing else WORSE; NEUTRAL = nothing WORSE and RIG TIE, or a pooled ADOPT with a negative RIG part; UNCLASSED = RIG N/A or MISSING, a guard MISSING, SKIPped, or user-overruled (asked at S4). Boundaries work iff at least one WIN with no unresolved flag. FLAGS (stop and ask, never a verdict; every flagged DECISION parks the driver until `ledger_cli ack-flag`; read on the pooled pair when one exists, the member's MDE printed): the margins of settled decision 7 against the matched clock-held twin -- turn facing_closed down >= 0.05, move_turn facing_closed down >= 0.10, any category's survival down >= 0.05, any walking speed ratio down >= 0.05; taps up > 25 %; swing_apex down >= 30 % (lift loss); support_feet down > 10 % in any category; with steps_guard_flag, steps_per_m / steps_per_rad adverse by > 15 % of X0's value; speed-driven (the steps members' mean delta/R on the BETTER side, their mean dlog step_rate_hz >= 0 and the T z > 0); removal verification failed. Removal-verification failures and the pilot stop (A6000's seed-3 line with RIG TIE, before its pair and before A4500) park at the seed-3 line, never deferred to the pooled line; a baseline screen that trips a floor parks too. Tripod is NOT a flag: a coherent tripod's score falls by construction as duty rises (coh x (1-d)/d), which is the success direction. Removal verification (hard checks): every HIDE eval shows clock_obs == 0 and the carry in run_meta; every clock-free stage ends with effective clock weights <= 0.001; clock_hidden_frac is 1.0 over the tail. WATCH, never scored: the cadence set (gait_hz, clock_hz, cadence_ratio, hz_speed_slope), offset_R, step_rate_hz, taps, swing_apex, the turn steps_per_rad split before and after closure, move_turn steps_per_rad and support_feet, stand support_feet, tripod, slip_per_m, the motion-quality ladder's Q members, six_down_frac, direction_error, cross_track_ratio, heading_final, settle_s, stand.drift_speed, both hands of every paired category and every per_category.demoted member with its reason; outside the row: saturation, training clock adherence, value loss and episode length over the 300 its after a removal, and R_twin(c4).
